verdict.rationale: Plaid's docs say Identity Verification integrates directly with its Monitor product to check users against watchlists and PEP lists as an end-to-end KYC solution. That covers sanctions and PEP screening from one vendor. However, screening runs through a separate companion product rather than inside the IDV check itself, and adverse-media screening is never mentioned. Missing for 10: adverse-media screening, evidence that screening runs inside the same IDV session/API call, evidence of a single unified review surface for screening hits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
